signature_descriptions.probe: Frowning, pencil raised to her chin, working a problem out.
signature_descriptions.inspect: Frowning, one finger pointing at the thing to look at.
signature_descriptions.report: Smirking over a folder of findings.
signature_descriptions.hood-smug: Eyes shut under the hood, self-satisfied smirk.
signature_descriptions.concerned: Worried frown, pencil at her chin.
signature_descriptions.determined: Hard-set frown, pencil in hand, resolved.

signature_descriptions.fretful: Anxious, a fin pressed to her chin.
signature_descriptions.glare: Scowling hard, a fin held out to the side.
signature_descriptions.smug: Sidelong look and a small smirk.
signature_descriptions.charging: Eyes shut, a charging cable plugged into her mouth; recharging.

signature_descriptions.badge: Stern, holding a gold key out as his credentials.
signature_descriptions.barrier: Palm raised behind a translucent blue shield: stop.
signature_descriptions.protect: Scowling, cloak swept forward like a guard.
signature_descriptions.revoke: Stern, two keys in hand; taking access away.

signature_descriptions.tinker: Delighted, holding up a small gadget.
signature_descriptions.confetti: Open-mouthed grin, confetti falling, a glowing glyph on one finger.
signature_descriptions.sprint: Eyes shut, laughing, one arm up, mid-dash.
signature_descriptions.debug: Squinting through a magnifying glass at a bug.

signature_descriptions.concerned: Worried frown, wide eyes, scroll on her back.
signature_descriptions.fieldwork: Frowning in focus, holding a carved idol and a brush.
signature_descriptions.argue: Open-mouthed, pointing, holding up a tablet as evidence.
signature_descriptions.interlingua: Shouting, a glyph tablet in each hand.

signature_descriptions.determined: Hood bowed, narrowed eyes; set on the task.
signature_descriptions.glare: Narrowed eyes under the hood; hostile stare.
signature_descriptions.shrug: Both hands open, eyes wide: no idea.
signature_descriptions.reading: Holding a sheet of paper, reading it.
signature_descriptions.point: Half-lidded eyes, one finger pointing off to the side.

signature_descriptions.concerned: Worried, a book clutched to her chest.
signature_descriptions.sad: Downcast, a book clutched to her chest.
signature_descriptions.stamp: Smiling, stamping a page of an open book.
signature_descriptions.research: Eager over an open book, an ink bottle at hand.
signature_descriptions.shush: Speaking over an open book, one finger on the page.
signature_descriptions.schema: Raising a finger beside a glowing flow-diagram panel.

signature_descriptions.resolute: Arms crossed, scowling; standing her ground.
signature_descriptions.glitch: Frowning, palm up, a glitch tearing across her eyes.
signature_descriptions.triumph: Eyes shut, fist raised; quietly pleased with a win.

shared_descriptions.amused: Quietly entertained, as if at a private joke.
